name: dataset_app
label: Dataset
subtitle: A project's datasets with size, checksum and which scripts read them
about: See the datasets of a project: files under data/ and registered datasets, each with size and SHA-256. Upload a file or register a path or URL already in the project. When a provenance provider is installed, see which scripts read each dataset.
description: SciTeX Dataset lists a project's data files and registered datasets with their size and SHA-256 checksum, lets maintainers upload files or register project paths and external URLs, and shows the provenance hook (the scripts recorded as reading each dataset) through a versioned, provider-neutral contract.
ai_hint: Dataset app: list a project's datasets (size, SHA-256), upload or register a dataset, and see which scripts read it.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: List data/ files and registered datasets with size and SHA-256
Upload a dataset file into data/
Register a project path or an external URL as a dataset
Detect when a registered dataset's bytes changed
Show the scripts that read each dataset (provenance hook)
